#Load required passages

```{r}
library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart.plot)
library(here)
```
#Load and clean Clinical Health Data

```{r}
heart_data <- read.csv(here("data","heart_cleaned.csv"))
```

#Balanced 80/20 Data Partitioning

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_index<-createDataPartition(heart_data$target,p=0.80,list=FALSE)
train_data<-heart_data[train_index,]
test_data<-heart_data[-train_index,]
```
